meta.name: upMVC Agent Scaffold Pack
meta.load_when: User opts in via --scaffold, confirms at CLI prompt, or adds a Cursor rule. Not part of default agent context.
meta.replaces: Legacy PHP generators (createmodule, modulegenerator, crudgenerator, ModuleGeneratorEnhanced) — removed from core repo

basic.description: Standard MVC module with index action

api.description: JSON API module — extend BaseApiController or return json_encode from controller

crud.description: Full CRUD web module with list/create/edit/delete

auth.description: Login/signup session module — reference Auth module in src/Modules/Auth
auth.middleware_notes: PROTECTED_ROUTES in .env; CSRF on POST; session_regenerate_id on login

dashboard.description: Admin-style dashboard shell — reference DashboardExample or Admin modules

saas_api.description: Tenant-scoped API domain module (requires SaaS pack)
saas_api.discovery: InitModsImproved scans Modules/*/Modules/*/Routes/Routes.php — the literal 'Modules' segment is required

field_schema.description: CRUD field definition for plan output — agent asks user or infers from goal

field_format.name: column name (snake_case)
field_format.html_type: text | email | number | textarea | select | radio | date | checkbox

route_patterns.note: Middleware is 4th argument array; HTTP methods 5th. No ->middleware() chaining.

scaffold_steps: Confirm module name (PascalCase) and type from module_types
Read a similar existing module in src/Modules/ before writing
Create files under src/Modules/{Name}/ with Routes/Routes.php for auto-discovery
Use addRoute(path, class, method, [middleware], [methods]) — never manual InitMods registration
Output JSON plan with files_touched and field list for CRUD — wait for approval
never: Do not write to modules/ (lowercase legacy path)
Do not edit InitMods.php or composer autoload per module
Do not use routes/ lowercase folder — use Routes/Routes.php
Do not run removed PHP generator scripts
